entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly. I want my money back.
Okay, I can help with that. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Here's the order number: VF12345. Look, I'm really frustrated. I need this resolved quickly.

Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order… Alright, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse placed on the 1st of the month. Today is the 16th. Our return window for electronics is 10 days. Unfortunately, your return request is outside of that window.

What?! Seriously? I just got this thing! It's barely been two weeks. That's ridiculous! I want to speak to a manager. This VeloBand Pulse is faulty. It doesn't read my heart rate correctly. I demand a refund!

I understand your frustration. While I can’t offer a full refund due to our policy, let’s see what we can do. I understand that the VeloBand Pulse isn't working as expected. Since you are outside the return window, a refund isn't possible. However, what I can offer you, as a policy exception due to the defect, is store credit for the value of the VeloBand Pulse. You can use this towards another VeloFit product.
Store credit? Ugh. I really wanted the money back. But I guess that's better than nothing. Can I use it on anything?

Yes, you can use the store credit on any item on the VeloFit website. It will be applied automatically at checkout. We also have a wide selection of replacement straps for the VeloBand Pulse in case you decide to purchase a new one, and this issue doesn't arise again.
Okay, fine. Store credit it is. How long will it take to show up in my account?
It will be applied to your account within 24 hours. You'll receive an email confirmation once it's available. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for actually doing something to help, instead of just reading the rules.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
